verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's pricing page lists a first-party "Safe rollouts" feature, and experiments support guardrail metrics. That points to metric-guarded releases, but no evidence describes how Safe rollouts detects regressions or whether it rolls back automatically. The only documented rollback is a manual Revert to an earlier revision. missing for 10: documented automatic rollback on metric regression, description of how Safe rollouts monitors metrics and detects regressions, guardrail metrics applied to feature rollouts (evidenced only for experiments), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically
